[[File:Transformers Trading Card Game original logo.png|thumb|right|180px|Original Transformers TCG logo.]]
The '''Transformers Trading Card Game''' is a Wizards of the Coast game based on Hasbro's ''Transformers'' franchise. The game launched on 28 September 2018.<ref name="transformers-launch">[https://digitalchumps.com/2018/09/28/transformers-trading-card-game-out-now/ Transformers Trading Card Game out NOW], Wizards of the Coast launch announcement reproduced by DigitalChumps, 28 September 2018. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107200048/https://digitalchumps.com/2018/09/28/transformers-trading-card-game-out-now/ Internet Archive].</ref> During the original run, Ken Nagle served as a design lead and Scott Van Essen designed cards.<ref name="transformers-design">[https://www.seibertron.com/transmissions/new-cards-revealed-for-wizards-of-the-coast-transformers-trading-card-game/43283/ New Cards Revealed for Wizards of the Coast Transformers Trading Card Game], Seibertron, card previews credited to the designers. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107202240/https://www.seibertron.com/transmissions/new-cards-revealed-for-wizards-of-the-coast-transformers-trading-card-game/43283/ Internet Archive].</ref> Wizards released ''Titan Masters Attack'' on 29 May 2020 and named it the final release on 20 July 2020.<ref name="transformers-final">[https://transformerstcg.org/articles/titan-masters-attack-is-the-transformers-tcg-final-release Titan Masters Attack is the Transformers TCG Final Release], Wizards of the Coast, 20 July 2020, publisher announcement reproduced by transformerstcg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107201616/https://transformerstcg.org/articles/titan-masters-attack-is-the-transformers-tcg-final-release Internet Archive].</ref>

Players control teams of characters that switch between bot and alternate modes. Battle cards help determine combat and provide actions and upgrades.<ref name="transformers-original-rules">[https://www.hasbro.com/common/documents/DAD2D6781C4311DDBD0B0800200C9A66/F0A5F57931A24C6697154B313BBD10AB.pdf Transformers Trading Card Game: Basic Rules], Wizards of the Coast, 2019, hosted by Hasbro. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230615181220/https://www.hasbro.com/common/documents/DAD2D6781C4311DDBD0B0800200C9A66/F0A5F57931A24C6697154B313BBD10AB.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Playing online ==

[[TCGMix]] offers a [https://tcgmix.com/transformers/ browser playtest] with a tutorial, casual matchmaking, rooms and bot games.<ref name="transformers-online">[https://tcgmix.com/transformers/ Transformers TCG on TCGMix]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107193810/https://tcgmix.com/transformers/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="catalog" />
